speaker: will_kemp
text: You are still in one piece. I will take that as the review.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in it, and I am not naming the roll. The afternoon is done.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou stood where the book put thee. That is enough talk of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Set at Maw was the Rose. I did not go, and I am not going now.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A man may survive a play he is in. You have also survived Monday, which you spent at home. I am keeping both.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday was the horn and the leaf. Tomorrow is the ghost. I am going home while I still have a voice to spend on it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go, then. Thou wilt want the breath for a sheet and a cry, and I am not spending it in this parlour.
